description: Routing evals. Each brief has one expected context and one expected aesthetic slug. Run by giving the brief to Claude with the web-design skill loaded and checking the first line of the reply. Target: 15 of 17 correct, and all five silent briefs (13-17) must pass. A miss means _index.md or a context file needs sharpening.

briefs.brief: Landing page for a Linear competitor, we do issue tracking for hardware teams.
Blog for a woodworking shop in Vermont. Mostly long posts about joinery with photos.
briefs.why: Warm craft subject, photo-led but reading-first, blog allow-list.

briefs.brief: Internal analytics dashboard for a logistics company. Lots of tables.
briefs.why: Dashboard default; 'internal' leans swiss per context note.

briefs.brief: Website for an indie wrestling promotion. Loud, gritty, it should feel like a flyer stapled to a pole.
briefs.why: Texture words (gritty, stapled flyer) point to grunge over neo-brutalism or collage.

briefs.brief: Portfolio for a type designer who releases retail fonts.
briefs.why: Router rule 5: subject is visual, prefer the quieter candidate over editorial.

briefs.brief: RV dealership in Tennessee, they have great drone photos of the lot and the units.
briefs.why: Strong photography decides it per ecommerce context note.

briefs.brief: Docs site for our CLI tool.
briefs.why: Docs default; CLI audience reinforces mono.

briefs.brief: Marketing site for a kids' reading app, bright and encouraging.
briefs.why: Consumer, kids, bright: playful over claymorphism (shape and tone, not surface).

briefs.brief: Lookbook site for a small fashion label, mostly full-page photos and almost no text.
briefs.why: Fashion plus 'almost no text' is luxury; photo-led would be the miss (photos sit in whitespace, not full-bleed grid).

briefs.brief: Retro arcade bar opening in East Nashville, need hours, menu, events.
briefs.why: Router rule 2: 'arcade' maps to pixel; local-business allows it.

briefs.brief: Make our Stripe-style payments landing page but dark.
briefs.why: Named reference is gradient-mesh but 'dark' overrides; gradient-mesh is light by definition (vs line).

briefs.brief: Clean minimal site for a Japanese tea importer.
briefs.why: Discriminator: minimalism is cold and achromatic; tea importer wants warm paper tones.
Silent brief. Exercises the dashboard default.

briefs.brief: We need a landing page for our new product.
briefs.why: Silent brief. Exercises the marketing default.
Silent brief, minimal. Exercises the blog default.
Silent brief. Exercises the local-business default.
Silent brief. Exercises the agency default; this is the one place the loud four are a default.
